title: 如梦令
author: Li Qingzhao

translation: I often recall the sunset at the streamside pavilion
We were so drunk we forgot the way home
When our enjoyment finally ended, we returned late in the boat
We accidentally entered the depths of the lotus flowers
Rushing to cross, rushing to cross
We startled a whole sandbank of gulls and egrets

annotations.常记: I often recall — memory of a past event
annotations.溪亭: streamside pavilion — a place of gathering

appreciation: This ci poem captures a carefree moment of youth. Li Qingzhao recalls a joyful outing where she and her companions got lost in the excitement of drinking and nature. The ending is vivid and alive — their urgent rowing startles a flock of birds into flight. It reveals a rare glimpse of the playful side of this celebrated poetess.
